content.en: You’re back! I’ve got one good news and one bad news.
content.zh: 你回来啦？我有一个好消息和坏消息。

content.en: Hm? What is it?
content.zh: 嗯？怎么了？

content.en: Uh, the bad news is… most of the people at our temple have been sent out to help prepare for the conference. Tonight’s the eve of the conference, after all.
content.zh: 额，坏消息是我们道观大部分人手都被派出进行大会准备了，今晚是大会前夕嘛。

content.en: I reported everything to my master, but there really isn’t anyone they can spare to help us right now.
content.zh: 我把事情汇报给了师父，但现在实在抽调不出人手来帮我们。

content.en: I see...
And the good news?
content.zh: 好消息呢？

content.en: The good news is, Master told me quite a lot of useful information. The city’s been unsettled lately, and the temple’s also been keeping an eye on that so-called Elysium Troupe.
content.zh: 好消息是师父告诉了我不少关于信息，最近市里不太平，道观也在观察那个什么极乐戏团。

content.en: And Master made an exception and let me keep borrowing the Ming Mirror! I just have to return it to the temple before tomorrow morning!
content.zh: 而且师父破格把明镜继续借给我了！明早之前还回道观就行！

content.en: Well, if he only sent you over, your master must really trust your abilities.
content.zh: 好吧，既然只叫你过来，你师父应该很相信你的能力。

content.en: When I went by the stalls just now, I saw people from that troupe too. Their clothes were exactly the same as the ones I saw on the plane.
content.zh: 我刚才去摊位的时候也看到那个戏团的人了，衣着和之前我在飞机上观察到的人一摸一样。

content.en: Mm. I also told Master about what you told me before. He said there must’ve been people from the troupe who slipped onto the plane.
content.zh: 嗯，我把你之前告诉我的事跟师父说了。他说飞机肯定混上了戏团的人。

content.en: My master says that although the Elysium Troupe only surfaced in the past few months, the methods they use resemble those of the local XiMu sect’s believers.
content.zh: 师父说这个极乐戏团虽然近几月才出现，但使用的手段和本地喜母教派的<color=red>信仰者</color>却有些类似。

content.en: Or rather, theirs are even more sinister. In the past two weeks there seem to have been a number of strange disappearances in the city.
content.zh: 额，不如说比之更邪性一点，最近这两个星期市内好像出现了不少奇怪的失踪案。

content.en: Does he have any guesses about how they’re controlling those people?
content.zh: 它们是用什么手段控制住那些人的，你师父有猜测吗？

content.en: Oh, right. Master said the local cultists themselves don’t have the ability to control others. They’re known instead for crafting textiles with strange properties.
content.zh: 啊对，师父说本地教派的信仰者并没有这种控制它人的能力，而是以制作拥有奇特效用的织物闻名。

content.en: He suspects the Elysium Troupe has found some way to distort Mother Xi’s blessing—implanting those threads into human bodies and causing that puppet-like transformation.
content.zh: 他猜测极乐戏团大概找到了什么方法扭曲了喜母的赐福，把丝线植入了人体，造成了那种类似人偶一样的异常转变。

content.en: But given what their abilities are based on, this kind of externally implanted transformation should be stoppable and reversible. So everyone on the plane can still be saved, as long as we can take down the ‘Puppeteer’ hiding in first class.
content.zh: 但考虑到信仰者能力的本质，这种外部植入的转变手段应该可以被停止和逆转，所以飞机上的人都还有救，只要我们能解决躲在头等舱的那个“偶师”。

content.en: What exactly are ‘believers’ in this sense?
content.zh: 信仰者到底是？

content.en: Oh, believers basically means people who gain special abilities or techniques through a medium of faith.
content.zh: 啊，信仰者简单来说就是通过信仰媒介获得了特殊能力或手段的人。

content.en: Alright. If I combine that with the clues I’ve gathered on my side, I think I finally have a plan to solve this.
content.zh: 好，结合之前我这里收集到的线索。我已经有一些解决事件的思路了。

content.en: Eh?
content.zh: 啊？

content.en: Give me a sec, I’m going to borrow a fire extinguisher.
content.zh: 稍等一下，我去借一个灭火器。

content.en: Eh? Eh??
content.zh: 啊？啊？

content.en: Oh, and a speaker. Page, come help me carry this.
content.zh: 对了，还有音响。周书，你也过来帮我拿一下吧。

content.en: people report relatives and friends vanishing without warning, and some witnesses say they saw acquaintances suddenly twist their arms backward like puppets—then disappear in the blink of an eye.
content.zh: 有人汇报亲朋好友忽然消失，还有目击者见到熟人忽然像木偶一样反转了手臂，之后眨眼间就消失了。
